verdict.rationale: smolagents is an open-source library supporting any LLM including local transformers/ollama models, not requiring vendor-hosted APIs, and offers a Docker-based sandbox alongside third-party options, allowing agents to run entirely on self-hosted infrastructure. CLI utilities and local code execution further support self-contained deployment. Missing for 10: explicit self-hosting/deployment guide, independent confirmation of fully air-gapped operation, and clarification that Hub-related features (push_to_hub, model Hub) are optional rather than required.
